<script>
    /*
      IMPORTANT:
      WhatsApp contact number in international format.
      Keep the country code and digits only, without +, spaces or dashes.
    */
    const WHATSAPP_NUMBER = "971588081538";

    function whatsappIsConfigured() {
      return /^\d{8,15}$/.test(WHATSAPP_NUMBER);
    }

    function openWhatsApp(message) {
      if (!whatsappIsConfigured()) {
        alert("Please add your real WhatsApp number in the website code first.");
        return;
      }

      const url = "https://wa.me/" + WHATSAPP_NUMBER
        + "?text=" + encodeURIComponent(message);

      window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
    }

    // Mobile navigation
    const menuToggle = document.getElementById("menuToggle");
    const navLinks = document.getElementById("navLinks");

    menuToggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
      const isOpen = navLinks.classList.toggle("open");
      menuToggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(isOpen));
      menuToggle.setAttribute(
        "aria-label",
        isOpen ? "Close navigation menu" : "Open navigation menu"
      );

      menuToggle.innerHTML = isOpen
        ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>'
        : '<i class="fa-solid fa-bars"></i>';
    });

    // Close mobile menu after navigation
    navLinks.querySelectorAll("a").forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener("click", function () {
        navLinks.classList.remove("open");
        menuToggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
        menuToggle.setAttribute("aria-label", "Open navigation menu");
        menuToggle.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-bars"></i>';
      });
    });

    // WhatsApp links
    const whatsappMessage = "Hello Oasis Pool Services, I would like to enquire about your services.";

    document.getElementById("floatingWhatsapp").addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      openWhatsApp(whatsappMessage);
    });

    document.getElementById("contactWhatsapp").addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      openWhatsApp(whatsappMessage);
    });

    // Service enquiry buttons preselect the service
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-service]").forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener("click", function () {
        document.getElementById("service").value = link.dataset.service;
      });
    });

    // Contact form opens a prefilled WhatsApp message
    document.getElementById("contactForm").addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
      event.preventDefault();

      if (!this.reportValidity()) return;

      const name = document.getElementById("name").value.trim();
      const phone = document.getElementById("phone").value.trim();
      const service = document.getElementById("service").value;
      const message = document.getElementById("message").value.trim();

      const text =
        "Hello Oasis Pool Services!\n\n" +
        "Name: " + name + "\n" +
        "Phone: " + (phone || "Not provided") + "\n" +
        "Service: " + service + "\n" +
        "Message: " + message;

      openWhatsApp(text);
    });

    // Premium count-up: eased numbers, staggered timing, and a subtle finish pulse.
    (function () {
      const counters = document.querySelectorAll(".stat-number[data-count]");
      const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
      let started = false;

      function animateCounter(el, delay) {
        const target = Number(el.dataset.count);
        if (!Number.isFinite(target)) return;
        el.textContent = "0";
        if (reducedMotion) {
          el.textContent = target.toLocaleString();
          return;
        }
        el.classList.add("is-counting");
        window.setTimeout(function () {
          const duration = 2300;
          const startTime = performance.now();
          function frame(now) {
            const progress = Math.min((now - startTime) / duration, 1);
            // Smooth ease-out with a little extra momentum near the finish.
            const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 4);
            el.textContent = Math.min(target, Math.floor(target * eased)).toLocaleString();
            if (progress < 1) {
              requestAnimationFrame(frame);
            } else {
              el.textContent = target.toLocaleString();
              el.classList.remove("is-counting");
              el.classList.add("is-done");
              window.setTimeout(function () { el.classList.remove("is-done"); }, 650);
            }
          }
          requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        }, delay);
      }

      function startCounters() {
        if (started) return;
        started = true;
        counters.forEach(function (counter, index) {
          animateCounter(counter, reducedMotion ? 0 : index * 220);
        });
      }

      const statsSection = document.querySelector(".stats-strip");
      if (statsSection && "IntersectionObserver" in window) {
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
          if (entries.some(function (entry) { return entry.isIntersecting; })) {
            startCounters();
            observer.disconnect();
          }
        }, { threshold: 0.25 });
        observer.observe(statsSection);
      } else {
        startCounters();
      }
    })();

    // Automatic copyright year
    document.getElementById("year").textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
